files.note: High oblique drone view from above the new south end-zone building looking north into the empty bowl, late-afternoon light (Nov 2024), with the completed south end zone facade in the foreground. Native size (already 16:9, 2048 px). Field centred horizontally (x ~650-1400) and in rows ~405-585 of 1150 (35-51%), so it sits at the top-40% line; the building facade fills the bottom half. Shows the stadium's current shape including the south end-zone enclosure.
